After hearing the matter, the Commission admitted the petition and issued notice to the Respondent. Petitioner to file its written submissions, if any, within 10 days, reserved the matter for order.

6. In view of the above, the only issue that arises for consideration is **_<u>whether the timeline prescribed under Regulation 10(3) of the REC Regulations, 2022 may be relaxed for issuance of RECs to HESCOM and GESCOM under Regulation 18 of the REC Regulations, 2022</u>_ .**

_The Commission may, from time to time, issue such practice directions and orders as considered appropriate for the implementation of these regulations_

11. In our view, the delay in the application for issuance of the REC is procedural in nature due to the reasons stated by the Petitioner and is not likely to prejudice any of the stakeholders, including the Respondent. Accordingly, the timelines stipulated under Regulation 10(3) of the REC Regulations 2022 are hereby relaxed, and the Petitioner is permitted to file its application for the issuance of RECs before the Central Agency for FY 2023-24.

12. Accordingly, the Respondent, NLDC, is directed to issue the RECs for FY 2023-24 to the Petitioner, PCKL, after due verification and satisfying itself that the Petitioner meets all other conditions and has submitted all the required documents for the issuance of RECs.
